herrera_cousins_14_individuals_in_group_.name: Herrera cousins (14 individuals in group chat)

scene.note: events declared visible to this actor are directly experienced

memories.content: Each cousin has their own preferences and constraints for the reunion. Three cousins privately prefer Oaxaca, two prefer San Antonio, and the others have not stated a strong preference. Tia Marisol, the eldest, privately intends to go with the majority but is more focused on catering details.

The Herrera cousins have an active group chat that has been running for a month. The chat includes all 14 cousins. The topic of the next spring's family reunion has been discussed, with three cousins advocating for Oaxaca, two for San Antonio, and Tia Marisol frequently changing the subject to catering. No decision on weekend or town has been made yet.
